author: blu
body: Proves Enchant-creature Auras. Holy Strength ("Enchanted creature gets +1/+2.") compiles to a StaticAbility BoostCreature; resolving it attaches it to the targeted creature, and the creature's effective power/toughness reads the boost off every attached Aura. The buff is dynamic -- remove the Aura and the bearer is a 2/2 again -- because it is summed at read time, not baked into the creature. Auras were inert before (enchantments got no abilities and never attached).
